visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a young woman with long dark hair and bangs sitting at a white table. She holds a small piece of green food, looking surprised toward the person off-camera. Her facial expressions are animated. The background shows a modern indoor setting with a large screen and soft warm lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a high-definition screen recording of an iPhone's alarm edit interface. A pair of hands interact with the touch screen, rapidly scrolling through the time selection wheels for hours and minutes. Yellow and white text captions are layered over the screen recording to emphasize the action. (3) The woman is shown again, now holding the smartphone and pointing at its display with her index finger. Her facial expression transitions from focused shock to amusement. She eventually bows her head and laughs, partially obscuring her face with the phone and her hands while maintaining high energy.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to share a surprising and somewhat obscure tech 'discovery' regarding the iPhone alarm clock's scrolling limits, presented through a high-energy, humorous interaction between two individuals to engage social media viewers.
